name: Biorthogonal Wavelet Compression
definition: A method where volume is partitioned in blocks which are transformed independently with either the biorthogonal 9/7-tap Daubechies wavelet filter or biorthogonal spline wavelets.
summary: Biorthogonal Wavelet Compression compresses volumetric data via multilevel transforms and thresholding, offering multiresolution behavior that better preserves statistical distributions than tensor approximation methods.
